collection.description: A well-meaning elder keeps suggesting partners to a villager who wants to choose independently.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder), a well-meaning elder, keeps suggesting partners to (villager), who wants to choose independently.

choices.label: Ask the Elder for General Advice
Let the Elder Know When Help Is Wanted

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (elder) is surprised but agrees to respect the boundary.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (elder) shares thoughtful stories without naming partners.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (villager) realizes they would rather seek no advice.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (villager) chooses to spend time with existing friends instead.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (villager) discovers that independent choice feels empowering.
